ops.oldText: for (i) Corio's internal business operations and (ii) production, testing, development, upgrade, reporting and training.
ops.newText: for (i) the internal business operations of Corio and its affiliates and (ii) production, testing, development, upgrade, reporting and training, in each case including use by contractors acting on Corio's behalf.

input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the internal use licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, consistent with our playbook position that the grant cover affiliates and contractors; the licence otherwise remains perpetual, paid-up and assignable in an M&A transaction under Section 14.1.
input.summary: Add affiliates and contractors to the Section 2.2 internal use licence.
